# reversedock_status (Data Source)

The running ReverseDock process (`GET /api/v1/status`; viewer role): version, configuration generation, readiness, and the whole document with listeners, providers, certificates and the last reload as `json`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reversedock_status" "this" {}

output "rdock_version" {
  value = data.reversedock_status.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `commit` (String) The commit it was built from.
- `generation` (Number) The generation of the configuration in use.
- `id` (String) Always `status`.
- `json` (String) The whole status document as JSON; decode it with `jsondecode`.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the proxy serves traffic.
- `started_at` (String) When the process started (RFC 3339).
- `version` (String) The ReverseDock version.
